main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 336-bar return over cells with forecast > 0

statistic.name: t of the forecast-weighted mean over cells

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope t >= 2); reject: < 0 with t <= -2 or slope t <= -2; at least 200 cells

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess return on forecast, t

decided_by: Inconclusive: the main measure's t is between -2 and 2 and no reject rule is met.
reading: The t of the weighted mean is the ordinary t of the per-cell values forecast x excess / mean forecast (whose mean equals the weighted mean), the coin's mean 336-bar return is taken on the same non-overlapping grid over all its windows, and the slope's t is the OLS slope over its standard error.
